page_title: WOL 1-1 NOT | Wolves v Nottingham Forest 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Max Kilman (Wolves) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matheus Cunha trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' The ball possession at the moment is 66:34.
85' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
85' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Chris Wood (Nottingham) for Anthony Elanga.
82' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Matt Turner comes off his line to gather the ball.
80' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
79' Wolves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
79' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
79' The free kick from long range, taken by Nottingham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
78' Steven Cooper is forced to make a change. Murillo is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Felipe (Nottingham).
76' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

75' Nice individual effort by Matheus Cunha (Wolves). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
73' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
73' A cross from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nottingham are going to take it.

71' Anthony Elanga picks out Ryan Yates (Nottingham), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.

70' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
69' Here is a change. Hugo Bueno is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Matt Doherty (Wolves).
69' It will be a substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is ready to enter the pitch as Pablo Sarabia walks off.
68' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
65' The free kick is delivered by Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
63' Steven Cooper decides to make a substitution. Cheikhou Kouyate will be replaced by Danilo (Nottingham).
62' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Jose Sa comes off his line to intercept.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Boubacar Traore is coming onto the pitch as Mario Lemina (Wolves) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
58' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
55' Having seen unsporting behavior, Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Steven Cooper (Nottingham) is the recipient.
52' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but only placed the ball against the crossbar!
52' The resulting corner from Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

52' Neco Williams (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nottingham.

50' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
50' Murillo (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Wolves are awarded the free kick.
49' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jose Sa.
47' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Jose Sa stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
45+3' Craig Dawson (Wolves) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header well wide of the right post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
43' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
42' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
39' What a beautiful long-range strike by Nelson Semedo (Wolves). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
37' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
32' The game has begun to heat up. Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.

32' 1 - 1 Goal! Pablo Sarabia displays great vision and sends a pass to Matheus Cunha (Wolves), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
31' A snap shot by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Matt Turner produces a good save to thwart him.
30' Joao Gomes (Wolves) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
29' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
28' Joao Gomes (Wolves) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
28' Neco Williams (Nottingham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Wolves.

26' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from inside the penalty box as he plants a header high over the bar! A typical school boy’s error! The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
23' Mario Lemina (Wolves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a throw-in.
19' Max Kilman (Wolves) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
17' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner which is cleared.
16' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
14' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Neco Williams sends a long raking pass onto the head of Harry Toffolo (Nottingham), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 0:1.
13' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
11' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) commits a foul and Samuel Barrott immediately signals a free kick.
6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jose Sa comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Nottingham hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Murillo (Nottingham) is able to continue to play.
2' Murillo (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Nottingham will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Samuel Barrott.
